subject: afi-2
title: AFI.(2)--------STY.
description: First of two diagrams in JR-16 (Jazz-Rock). The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'Jazz-rock is thus the form that represents the re-entering of the bi-aitional principle as a factor to participate in the forming of a possible composite alternative creative music (or at least jazz-rock in its pure state — if I can use that term — with respect to the unadulterated intentions it affirms, can be viewed in this context).' The crossing diagrams how affinity-insight second-degree structurally meets style at the jazz-rock-bi-aitional scale: AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree — the form's actual second-degree insight) crossed with STY (style). AFI-2 sits on the left with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs up-right to STY at top-center as partner-axis; VT-PLT (vibrational platform) sits centrally. CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) branches from the main line to the right, with AF-DY (affinity dynamics) at upper-right off CULT-AF-B's line and OP-SD (option spread) off AF-DY's line. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) drops from the main line to the bottom-center and carries MT-INFO (multi-information), from whose line VT-PLT rises, with PART (participation) off VT-PLT's line. INFO-SOLD (information solidification) hangs at the lower-left and TRS (transition) at the bottom-left as the subject-side downward outputs. The subject's TRS → INFO-SOLD chain is what affinity-insight second-degree produces alone — transition into information-solidification, the form's own working axis without the partner-axis chain.
